context_threshold_scope: Per model request, using full input. More than 272000 input tokens reprices the full request. Aggregate turn input is not one model request.
input_partition: ordinary_input_tokens = total_input_tokens - cached_input_tokens - cache_write_input_tokens; ordinary, cache-read and cache-write prices are alternatives, not additive.
output_partition: Reasoning output is already included in output_tokens and must not be added again.
estimate_kind: API list-price-equivalent; not actual ChatGPT/Codex billing

provenance.reading_scope: Official API pricing, flagship Standard/Batch/Flex/Fast/Ultrafast rows, regional footnote and tool billing notes; selected sections, not every model.
Exact GPT-6.1 Sol model identity, pricing, >272K condition and tier multipliers; model main content reviewed.
Main caching guide, input partition, cache-write rates and usage fields, model comparison and cost calculation; selected sections, not every example.

native_usage_caveat: Codex 0.159.2 JSONL reports cache_write_input_tokens, but its wire parser defaults a missing upstream cache_write_tokens field to zero. A reported zero does not prove upstream explicit zero.
cache_write_sensitivity: Report native-reported W point estimate and an all-noncached-input-written sensitivity: set W = total_input_tokens - cached_input_tokens. This is a hypothetical upper scenario under the same tariff, not observed billing.
unknowns: Actual account tariff, discounts and charges

Whether native-reported cache-write zero was explicit upstream zero or parser default
